title: Target the Ego or Target the Group: Evidence from a Randomized Experiment in Proactive Churn Management
authors: Miguel Godinho de Matos; Pedro Ferreira; Rodrigo Belo
eligible_reason: Not a DiD. Randomized experiment in proactive churn management (target ego vs. group); ITT regressions of retention/churn on treatment arm with churn-propensity control and period dummies.
design_notes: paper.mksc_replication.rmd: lm(flg_reactive_retention_120days ~ lab.treatment + churn_prob + factor(period_id)) for egos and alters, plus compliance and CLV regressions. Cross-sectional by randomization wave; no unit FE or adoption timing.
data_provenance_note: README: noise added to numeric household variables, alters randomly sub-sampled, cluster IDs regenerated.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract is a one-sentence summary. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
